description: Source code for managing note version history, including saving, listing, and restoring note versions, with integration to SQLite and version store.

classes.name: NoteVersionsFlow
classes.description: Handles orchestration of note version history, including saving, listing, and restoring versions.

methods.name: save_version
methods.description: Saves a snapshot of the current note as a new version.

methods.name: list_versions
methods.description: Lists all versions of a note, newest first.

methods.name: restore_version
methods.description: Restores a specific version into the current note and records the restore as a new version.
